name: The University of Texas at El Paso

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - The University of Texas at El Paso

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025 first-years): 12,350 of 12,357 applicants admitted (99.9%); international 295 of 301 admitted, 190 enrolled. GPA bands are the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (a further 0.24% had GPA below 1.0). Only 91 enrollees submitted SAT and 129 ACT scores (C9), so the score percentiles describe a very small, self-selected group. The CDS C7 importance marks could not be read from the PDF text, so admission factors are omitted. Undergraduate enrollment 22,223 is CDS B1 total undergraduates; 843 is degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates (B2). Student-faculty ratio 21:1 is from IPEDS College Navigator.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT marked 'required for some' applicants.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year full-year amounts for 2026-27 (nonresident tuition equals out-of-state; per credit hour $787 nonresident vs $262 in-state). The $11,500 food-and-housing line is printed without a label in the extracted text and is read as on-campus food and housing. CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid exists for nonresidents; 373 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received aid (avg $10,216, total $3,810,516).
